ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As illustrated in the figure, $AB \parallel CD \parallel EP$, given that $\frac{AC}{CE} = \frac{3}{2}$ and $BD = 12$, what is the length of $DF$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given $\because AB\parallel CD\parallel EP$, $\frac{AC}{CE}=\frac{3}{2}$, and $BD=12$, \\
$\therefore \frac{AC}{CE}=\frac{BD}{DF}=\frac{3}{2}$, \\
$\therefore \frac{12}{DF}=\frac{3}{2}$, \\
$\therefore DF=\boxed{8}$
